summary:
We developed a space exploration game consisting of 3 levels which are, beginner, intermediate and difficult level. It exists in one website so that anyone,- yes, even those who are not interested in space, can start a fun digital space adventure. the website even includes a bot to ask questions, quiz you and give fun facts.

 The beginner level is a simple game about a space cadet exploring space. This exists as an fun, early exposure about space and exploration. there are 4 levels which include little puzzles and small fun facts about space. Then, the intermediate level is about exploring mars, landing rockets and others. Lastly the difficult level is about creating a viable space craft on to land on different types of planets, facing obstacles to reach the planet and more.

  It addresses the challenge introducing space knowledge and real life problems faced by astronauts - and piquing interest to non-space enjoyers to understand about space. This is important to increase the amount of space knowledge amongst students and non-space enjoyers as a whole. we hope this can overcome the challenge faced to influence others into also enjoying space.

Space Explore – Game Description

Space Explore is an interactive educational game designed to introduce players to the fascinating world of space exploration. It combines learning and entertainment by allowing players to discover information about the Solar System, rockets, orbits, signals, and space missions.

The game features several educational sections, including planet sizes, distances from the Sun, planetary years, rocket launches, satellite orbits, and communication with the International Space Station (ISS). Players can also learn about important space exploration milestones and different destinations, such as the Moon, Mars, asteroids, and Europa.

Space Explore includes three main games with different difficulty levels. Signal to Space is a beginner-level game that teaches players about space communication. Mars Touchdown is an intermediate game where players must control a spacecraft and land safely on Mars. Mission Architect is a master-level game that allows players to design and plan space missions.

The game also provides interactive quizzes, achievements, saved scores, and exciting challenges to keep players motivated. With its space-themed visuals, sound effects, and interactive controls, the game creates an enjoyable learning experience.

Overall, Space Explore helps players develop their knowledge of astronomy, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills while exploring the wonders of the universe through fun and engaging gameplay.
